name: Blinded
summary: Cannot see and automatically fails checks that require sight.

name: Charmed
summary: Cannot attack the charmer and the charmer has advantage on social checks.

name: Deafened
summary: Cannot hear and automatically fails checks that require hearing.

name: Frightened
summary: Disadvantage while the source of fear is in sight and cannot willingly move closer.

name: Grappled
summary: Speed becomes 0 until the grapple ends.

name: Invisible
summary: Cannot be seen without special senses or magic.

name: Paralyzed
summary: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, and is especially vulnerable to attacks.

name: Petrified
summary: Transformed into a solid substance and incapacitated.

name: Poisoned
summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
summary: Can crawl, has disadvantage on attacks, and nearby attackers gain advantage.

name: Restrained
summary: Speed becomes 0 and attacks against the creature have advantage.

name: Stunned
summary: Incapacitated, cannot move, and can speak only falteringly.

name: Unconscious
summary: Incapacitated, unaware, prone, and drops held items.

name: Exhaustion
summary: A cumulative condition with worsening penalties by level.
